name: ResearchReceipt
tagline: A GenLayer research delivery workbench that locks buyer criteria, commit-pinned GitHub sources, and four-field unknown disclosures for verifiable consensus receipts.
description: ResearchReceipt is a bilingual (EN default / ZH switchable) web app and GenLayer Intelligent Contract (policy research-receipt/6) for reviewing commissioned research. Buyer and author lock a 4-to-6-criterion rubric, permitted GitHub repo roots, and whether each criterion requires established facts (fact_required) or allows a structured 4-field unknown disclosure (target_aspect, examined_sources, unverified_reason, risk_boundary). Execution uses two transactions: verify_evidence locks raw GitHub bytes into an immutable snapshot, and evaluate runs leader/validator consensus with zero source HTTP. Deployed on public Bradbury Phase 2 testnet (chainId 4221) at 0x10d41bf2e9b54440ced622171ceff191754bcf73 (v6-wallet-4), all 51/51 prelocked cases (40 RETURN + 11 ERROR, 9 orders) finalized with accepted MAJORITY_AGREE consensus. Earlier v1-v5, v6-wallet-2 revert, and v6-wallet-3 (46/51) attempts are retained in docs/evidence. Testnet only; not mainnet, production-ready, universal model accuracy, or external audit.

steps.title: Inspect the default English walkthrough and switch EN / ZH
steps.instructions: Open https://research-receipt-lab.milkyhoop.chatgpt.site/. The app loads in English by default (with an EN / ZH toggle in the top bar). In Demo Walkthrough mode, inspect Revision v1 (NOT_ACCEPTED due to a contradicted 24-hour withdrawal delay claim) and Revision v2 (ACCEPTED after correcting the source-bound claim), then click Export JSON Receipt.

steps.title: Read finalized Bradbury Phase 2 testnet (chainId 4221) v6-wallet-4 orders
steps.instructions: Switch to Live Testnet mode (default preset: Bradbury Phase 2 public testnet, chainId 4221, policy research-receipt/6). Without connecting a wallet, inspect contract 0x10d41bf2e9b54440ced622171ceff191754bcf73 (Order #1 negative->revised positive, Order #2 strict unknown->fact proven, Order #3 hash mismatch->corrected, Order #8 optional source omitted, Order #9 6-criterion evaluation). Click Refresh On-Chain Order to read live finalized state via public RPC.

steps.title: Verify the v6 two-stage snapshot boundary and historical Studio-dev simulator
steps.instructions: Review the v6 two-step write boundary (Step 1: Lock Evidence Snapshot via verify_evidence; Step 2: Run Consensus Evaluation via evaluate) and the 51/51 public testnet evidence bundle in docs/evidence/bradbury-v6-wallet-4-e2e.json. Optionally switch the preset to Studio-dev (chainId 61997, contract 0xa73d09fE5f065ECa8d05b3371cDC5E91213319f1), which is a hosted development simulation running historical policy research-receipt/1.

No wallet signature is required for read-only verification.
